entries.intent: item has the ordinary explicit Lightning Resistance suffix
entries.notes: No exact official Trade stat filter was found for the ordinary explicit Lightning Resistance suffix in this workflow. Do not guess text. Search without this filter and post-filter collected item mods for an actual suffix line matching '+X% to Lightning ResistanceS*'. Exclude PSEUDO total, Rune, hybrid resistance, and other non-ordinary sources.

entries.intent: item grants increased global Critical Hit Chance
entries.notes: Do not substitute Critical Damage Bonus. PoE2DB shows generic Critical Hit Chance on some ring sources/uniques, while ordinary rare ring affixes prominently include Spell Critical Hit Chance. Must verify exact official Trade UI/catalog behavior before combining into rare-ring searches.
